summary.text: Vince George is a retired public policy analyst and the Democratic nominee for West Virginia's 1st District. According to his Ballotpedia survey responses, he has worked as a teacher, social worker and state and federal programs' eligibility examiner, and he has run for office before. He won the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary and lists Medicare for All or a single-payer public option, raising the federal minimum wage to at least $15 an hour, and ending U.S. involvement in overseas wars as his key messages.

paragraphs.text: George describes himself as raised in Dunbar and South Charleston, West Virginia, where he attended public schools with four younger siblings.
He earned a graduate degree from West Virginia University in 1984.

His career experience includes work as a policy analyst, social worker, federal and state programs' eligibility examiner and teacher (a WVEA member), and he describes himself as a retired AFSCME member.
George describes past roles as a student government office holder, political candidate, campaign consultant and conservation lobbyist.
He won the Democratic nomination in the May 12, 2026 primary, defeating Britta Aguirre 53.0% to 47.0%.
News coverage describes him as a retired public servant, former teacher and community advocate from South Charleston, and he lists two children and three grandchildren in his own materials.

sources.title: Vince George wins Democratic nod in US House District 1 race
